sourceIndependence: Indian government official statements; other republications of same ministry release are not independent corroboration
caveats: The 56 critical blocks are cumulative and 10 seventh-tranche blocks are included; do not add.
The 22 critical FY2025-26 blocks are included within 212 all-mineral FY2025-26 auctions.
The 30 operationalised all-mineral blocks do not establish commissioning of critical-mineral processing or mining projects.
State operationalisation counts are components of the national 30.
Successful auction does not mean cash disbursement, extraction or recovered tonnes.
Government reports are primary administrative evidence, not independent financial or production audits.
No causal connection to Quad cooperation is demonstrated.
